title: CSV persistence
prompt: Implement `static string SaveCsv(List<Transaction> ledger, string dir)` — write each transaction as one CSV line `id,dir,amount,category` (dir as "income"/"expense", amount invariant) into `<dir>/ledger.csv`, creating the directory; return the full path.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Directory creation, line format, and plain decimal output.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Empty file, directory creation, and fractional amounts — invariant culture keeps the dot.
